name: FeTA Challenge
description: Assesses fetal brain tissue annotation/segmentation across multi-center fetal MRI data.
evaluation_method: Dice coefficient (Dice / F1) and IoU as primary metrics; Hausdorff distance and boundary metrics for anatomical accuracy
typical_sota_score: ≈70–90% (Dice, varies by tissue class and site)
reputation: Well-regarded within fetal MRI research as a multi-center challenge for fetal brain tissue segmentation.
notes: Multi-center variability and class imbalance; requires expert annotations; sensitive to preprocessing and scanner differences; relatively small/clinical dataset and not applicable to LLMs.
